# PDF Toolkit AI

> Free online PDF tools — compress, merge, split, convert, OCR and AI-powered document processing. 100% in-browser, no signup, no watermark, files never leave your device. Available in English and Chinese.

## Core PDF Tools

- [PDF Converter](https://wezzik.com/convert-pdf.html): Convert PDF to Word, Excel, JPG and more. No signup, no watermark, 100% private.
- [PDF Editor](https://wezzik.com/edit-pdf.html): Merge, split, rotate and delete PDF pages entirely in the browser.
- [AI PDF Tools](https://wezzik.com/ai-pdf-tools.html): Summarize long documents, chat with PDFs and extract key insights with GPT/Claude, processed locally for privacy.
- [Business PDF Tools](https://wezzik.com/business-pdf-tools.html): Generate invoices, resumes and contract templates; edit, sign and share business documents.
